data.name: Mehvishah
data.gender_notes: Mehvishah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Beautiful One Who Lives in the Meadow. The name Mehvishah carries the meaning “Graceful Meadow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Mehvishah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who embodies the beauty and grace of nature and inspires peace and tranquility in those around her.
data.etymology: Mehvishah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful Meadow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehvishah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مهفيشة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من مهف و يشير إلى القمر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مهفيشة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي مهف و يعني القمر أو نور القمر، و هو اسم مؤنث يطلق على الإناث في الثقافة الإسلامية، و يشير إلى الجمال و الإشراق

in_urdu.name: مہویشہ
in_urdu.meaning: چاند کی روشنی، چاند جیسی حسین
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہویشہ ایک مشہور اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جذر 'مهف' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے چاند یا چاند کی روشنی، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور چمک کے مفہوم کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मेहविश
in_hindi.long_meaning: मेहविश एक लोकप्रिय मुस्लिम नाम है जो अरबी जड़ 'مهف' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है चाँद या चाँद की रोशनी, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सौंदर्य और प्रकाश के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: مهفيشه
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهفيشه د يوې ښځې نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې د جذر 'مهف' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، مانا یې د چاد روښانه یا چاد پورې اړوند دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې د ښکلا او نور مفاهیمو سره کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Mehvishah
in_english.long_meaning: Mehvishah is a popular Islamic name derived from the Arabic root 'مهف', meaning moon or moonlight, it symbolizes beauty, radiance, and luminosity, widely used across Muslim cultures, reflecting the celestial and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Mehvishah is of Persian origin and is often used in Islamic communities. Its meaning, "The Beautiful One Who Lives in the Meadow," evokes images of tranquility, nature, and beauty. Mehvishah is a name that is not only beautiful to the ear but also represents elements of culture and tradition in many Islamic societies where Persian influences are strong.
data.spiritual_significance: Mehvishah is not only a beautiful name but also holds spiritual significance in Islamic culture. The name suggests a deep connection to nature and the belief that beauty can be found in the simplest of things. In Islam, nature is often used as a metaphor for Allah's creations and the wonders of the natural world are a reminder of His power and majesty. The name Mehvishah can be seen as a reminder of the beauty and blessings that Allah has bestowed upon us and serves as a reminder to find joy and peace in the simple things in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful Meadow" symbolizes The Beautiful One Who Lives in the Meadow. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mehvishah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful meadow.
